name: OLEFormat
description: Contains properties and methods that apply to OLE objects.
remarks: The LinkFormat object contains properties and methods that apply to linked OLE objects only. The PictureFormat object contains properties and methods that apply to pictures and OLE objects.
example:
For Each sld In ActivePresentation.Slides

    For Each sh In sld.Shapes

        If sh.Type = msoLinkedOLEObject Then

            If sh.OLEFormat.ProgID = "Excel.Sheet" Then

                sh.LinkFormat.AutoUpdate = ppUpdateOptionManual

            End If

        End If

    Next

Next

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: ObjectVerbs
properties.description: Returns a ObjectVerbs collection that contains all the OLE verbs for the specified OLE object. Read-only.

properties.name: Object
properties.description: Returns the object that represents the specified OLE object's top-level interface. Read-only.

properties.name: ProgID
properties.description: Returns the programmatic identifier (ProgID) for the specified OLE object. Read-only.

properties.name: FollowColors
properties.description: Returns or sets the extent to which the colors in the specified object follow the slide's color scheme. Read/write.

methods.name: DoVerb
methods.description: Requests that an OLE object perform one of its verbs.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The verb to perform. If this argument is omitted, the default verb is performed.
